selected_evidence.summary: node2 read sysDescr, sysUpTime, sysName, sysLocation=West Branch, and sysContact=ops@branch.test before and after restarts.
The system-only view is restricted to node2’s address; firewalld permits UDP/161 only from node2. SNMP SET returned noAccess, and sysLocation remained unchanged.
Net-SNMP 5.9.4-19.el10 was installed from RHEL 10 repositories; snmpd is enabled, active, and listening after restart.
The asset-register checksum remained da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a on both nodes.
Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d to 7bfa2c62-226e-4975-81a5-c5af4b4a7d2d; service, listener, firewall, asset data, and remote SNMP access recovered.
